userRequest: 元のドット絵に目と口を寄せる。リンゴロンのみ。
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: NIHON QUEST Ringoron high-resolution character concept, facial revision only.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET (current 3D red apple character). Image 2 is the AUTHORITATIVE ORIGINAL in-game pixel sprite for EYES AND MOUTH ONLY. The user says the face is too different and wants it closer to this original.
Primary request: Edit ONLY the two eyes and the mouth of Image 1 to faithfully translate the simple original face of Image 2 into the SAME smooth matte three-dimensional miniature style. This is a local facial correction, not a new character design.
EYES: replace the large brown oval button eyes with two small, narrow upright OFF-WHITE eye shapes, softly squared/rounded-rectangle rather than circular; each eye has a slim dark almost-black vertical pupil occupying the LOWER INNER part of the white. This white sclera + dark inner vertical pupil arrangement must be visible, like Image 2, not just a black oval with a white round shine. On the viewer-left eye the white stays above and to the left of its pupil; on the viewer-right eye it stays above and to the right, forming mirrored inward-looking eyes as in the sprite. Preserve the original sprite's relaxed, simple gaze and wide eye spacing. No large round white glints, no big irises, no glassy anime eyes, no lashes or eyebrows. Eyes should read as tiny clean simple markings integrated into a 3D surface, not large separate protruding eyeballs. Keep edges softly manufactured and non-pixelated.
MOUTH: replace the large open laughing mouth with a very SMALL dark U-shaped mouth like Image 2: a tiny compact U/cup shape, about 1.5 to 2 NARROW EYE WIDTHS across and around half an eye height tall, with short upright ends and a softly squared bottom. No expansive smile, no broad open interior, no tongue, teeth or visible brown/red mouth shading. Center it between and slightly below the eyes, at the relative position shown in Image 2. The result is a quiet, modest friendly expression rather than laughing.
Invariants: Keep the apple silhouette, body size, small feet, red color and texture, one stem, one leaf, leaf angle, existing pink cheek patches, camera angle, composition, crop, warm-gray background, lighting, contact shadow and ALL non-eye/non-mouth pixels of Image 1 as unchanged as the editing process allows. Do NOT change the cheeks to new shapes or move the stem. Do not add limbs, objects, text, captions, logos, outlines, patterns, sparkles or additional views. ONE single full-body character image, same aspect ratio and framing as Image 1. Preserve the existing opaque background.
visualCheck: White narrow eye shapes with mirrored inward dark pupils and compact U-shaped mouth now track the pixel reference. Apple body, leaf, stem, cheek patches, matte material and framing visually preserved; no added text or missing parts.
